title: The Potters' Studio Electric Firing Service
summary: Drop off work for electric bisque (cone 05) or mid-fire (cone 6) at the studio's main entrance (10am–5pm, 7 days a week). Turnaround is up to 3 weeks. Members pay $19.55–$22.55 per cubic foot; non-members $35–$43.50 per cubic foot. $50 minimum charge applies.
cost_text: Bisque (cone 05): Members $19.55/cu ft, non-members $35.00/cu ft. Mid-fire (cone 6): Members $22.55/cu ft, non-members $43.50/cu ft. $50 minimum charge.
bring: Completely dry work; glazed work must not have glaze on the bottom
how_to_join: Bring work to the studio's main entrance at 724 Camelia Street (4th Street side), Berkeley CA 94710, during regular hours 10am–5pm daily. Payment due at drop-off.
evidence_sentence: The studio fires work in electric kilns to cone 05 (bisque/low-fire) and cone 6 (mid-fire) on a rolling basis.
evidence_quote: We offer low, mid, and high-fire services in our electric and cone 10 gas kilns on a contract basis.
source_quote: We offer low, mid, and high-fire services in our electric and cone 10 gas kilns on a contract basis. No reservations necessary – just bring in your work to our main entrance on 4th Street during regular daytime staff hours (7 days a week, 10am to 5pm).
pay_text: Payment due at time of drop-off. Bisque (cone 05): Members $19.55/cu ft, non-members $35.00/cu ft. Mid-fire (cone 6): Members $22.55/cu ft, non-members $43.50/cu ft. $50 minimum charge.
